info.name: UniMart Backend - Complete API Test
info.description: Run folders 01, 02, 02b, 03, 04, 05, and 06 in order using Postman Collection Runner against a freshly migrated local database. Start Django with `.venv/bin/python manage.py runserver`. Create a staff account using `.venv/bin/python manage.py createsuperuser`; set admin_username and admin_password below. Create at least one active meetup location via Django admin or `.venv/bin/python manage.py shell -c "from transactions.models import MeetupLocation; MeetupLocation.objects.get_or_create(name='Library Gate')"`. Folder 01 creates unique demo users per run. Folder 07 is manual because Postman needs a selected local image file. WebSocket chat is tested separately; see README.md. The collection leaves generated demo data in the database.

item.name: 01 - Setup and authentication
item.description: Run this folder first. Set admin_username and admin_password in collection variables. The first request creates fresh usernames for each run.

item.name: 02 - Categories and listings
item.description: Creates three listings: one completed sale, one cancelled request, and one rejected request.

item.name: 02b - Saved listings and chat
item.description: Runs before transactions while the main listing is available. WebSocket instructions are in the backend README.

Seller archives listing with pending request

item.description: Requires one active MeetupLocation. Create it through Django admin before running: .venv/bin/python manage.py shell -c "from transactions.models import MeetupLocation; MeetupLocation.objects.get_or_create(name='Library Gate')"

item.name: 04 - Reviews

exec: pm.test("Rating summary", () => { const x = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(x.review_count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(x.average_rating).to.eql(5); });

item.description: Reviews are available only after a completed transaction.

item.description: Tests user visibility and staff review, resolve, and reject actions.

item.description: Run last; logout blacklists the buyer refresh token.
